guide.title: How It Works
guide.p1: Welcome to PetMed Navigator | Decision Assistant. Please follow the steps below:
guide.step1: Upload or paste your pet's medical report (blood tests, imaging, or veterinary conclusions are all acceptable)
guide.step2: Briefly describe your pet's situation (age, symptoms, quality of life, and your budget)
guide.step3: After submission, you will receive a personalized "Decision Guide"
guide.step4: The "Decision Guide" includes: 1) Plain-language interpretation of the medical report 2) Common prognosis and treatment pathway references 3) A checklist of key questions to discuss with your veterinarian
guide.importantDesc: Reviewed by human specialists. Feedback is guaranteed within 24 hours.
guide.importantDesc2: This tool is for understanding and communication support only and does not replace veterinary diagnosis.
